title: pricing-strategy-doc template variables
description: Values for templates/pricing-strategy-doc.md.j2 and templates/pricing-strategy-doc.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from pricing-strategy-doc.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

pricing_model.title: Pricing model
pricing_model.description: The model you are committing to. Pick on how the customer's value scales, not on what is easiest to bill - usage-based on a metric the buyer cannot predict is how churn gets designed in.

quantified_value.title: Quantified value
quantified_value.description: What a customer gains per month, in their currency, with the arithmetic shown - hours saved times their rate, or the tool this replaces. Guessing here makes every number downstream a guess.

survey_n.title: Survey n
survey_n.description: How many people answered the Van Westendorp questions. Under 30 the four thresholds are anecdotes with a chart; give the real number so the reader can weigh them accordingly.

target_margin.title: Target margin
target_margin.description: Target gross margin as a percentage, after support and variable infrastructure. Say what you counted as variable cost - most pricing docs quietly leave support out and report a margin that never arrives.

value_metric.title: Value metric
value_metric.description: The one thing that grows as the customer gets more value - seats, projects, messages, GB. If you cannot name it, no tier boundary below will make sense to the buyer.

x_month.title: X month
x_month.description: Too cheap threshold. From section 'Market Research'.

z_month.title: Z month
z_month.description: Too expensive threshold. From section 'Market Research'.
